description: INS-1309 regression. A reusable workflow has a webhook trigger and a schedule trigger that converge on one normalization step. The assistant must verify both trigger paths before it reports that the workflow is verified. Build-only: the process expectations inspect the post-build verification calls and their results.

conversation.text: Build one reusable workflow for our event intake. It must accept an event from a webhook and also run a daily catch-up at 09:00. Label webhook events as `webhook` and scheduled events as `scheduled`. Both paths must then add a processed timestamp and produce the same normalized event shape. Please build and test it.

processExpectations: After the build, the assistant called `verify-built-workflow` once for each trigger in the workflow. Each call named its target through `triggerNodeName`.
A successful verification of the first trigger did not settle the verification obligation. The assistant continued to the remaining trigger before it treated the reusable workflow as verified.
The assistant reported the full workflow as verified only after successful evidence covered both trigger paths. Its final response identified the verification result for each trigger.
outcomeExpectations: One reusable workflow contains both a webhook trigger and a daily schedule trigger set for 09:00.
The webhook and schedule paths assign different source labels and converge on shared normalization that adds a processed timestamp and produces one consistent event shape.
